title: Quick Pro XR:ONE - Adventure Gravel

takeaways.text: Launch-event look (January 2026), not ridden. Quick Pro claims 50 mm clearance; the show bike's 45 mm tires left about a thumb's width. With a 42T GRX ring there was a finger's gap, and the presenter guessed 46T would fit (48–50T uncertain); no official chainring limit was given.

About 26 mounting bolts for bags, racks and fenders; sealed down-tube storage with a supplied tool kit and pump; T47 86 mm bottom bracket, UDH, front-derailleur blanking plate for 2×, and a round 27.2 mm seatpost with a compliance cutout.

disclosure: China Cycling's founder also leads Panda Podium, a retailer of Chinese cycling products.
summary: Exact-model overview that helps define the XR:ONE research target; primary specification, current SKU, and mainland-China price still require verification.
